environment.description: Rails 7.0 API application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with default task definition. Container runs as root with default Linux capabilities. SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY and HMAC_SECRET are set to the hardcoded defaults because the environment variables are not configured in the task definition. The application is exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no additional middleware or filtering. Inter-container communication is unrestricted on the bridge network.
